seal.statement: The control-plane readiness service is one class whose collaborators (system-table cache, planning snapshot source, node service rows, clock) are named constructor parameters validated once at construction, replacing the nine-deep extends chain across the 24 control-plane-readiness-*.js files; the planning-answer chain (getMembershipPublicationPlanningAnswerSync, getPriorityRecoveryPlanningAnswerSync and their snapshot forms) is one method with one name, and its three consumers (partition-service-learner-promotion-methods.js, replica-operation-repository-visibility-methods.js, unified-rebalancer-available-nodes.js) call it without typeof checks; readiness behaviour and every existing witness are unchanged.
